sequence_description: Token exchange should enforce that the subject_token is intended for the requesting client. Obtain an access token via SAML-brokered OIDC for client_id, then attempt RFC8693 token_exchange using the same client credentials but requesting a different audience (project_id). If ZITADEL ignores subject_token audience constraints when the exchanging client is the same as the original, it may mint a token for an audience not covered by the upstream intent.
